description:
Group of Two (G2) represents the geopolitical relationship between the USA and China, the two SUPERPOWERS of the 21st century.

It focuses on cooperation, managed competition, and mutual benefit. While US-China cooperation cannot solve all global problems, many challenges will be difficult to resolve WITHOUT it.

The ATC-20 G2 token gives all supporters, holders, and traders instant finality, ultra-low fixed gas fees, and AI contract capability, making it a fast & secure digital asset worldwide.
name: Group of Two
